Why movo picked this — for you
Boutique stays
Hotel Bethel — a quiet harbour house on Nyhavn's calm side. Canal-view corners, no lobby music.
Movo holds the canal-view corner room — plane-tree light in the morning. Picked because you rated Moab's desert lodge 5★ and skip big hotels every time.
expand_more
Slow mornings
Nothing booked before 10. Kanelsnegle through a Toldbodgade window, harbour steam, coffee where the fishermen were.
Your first activity never starts before 10 — the plan protects it even when things reshuffle. Picked because you linger over breakfast on every trip movo has watched.
expand_more
Street food
Torvehallerne stalls mapped between sights — smørrebrød at Hallernes, duck-confit dogs by the harbour.
Three food stops are pre-mapped between sights, so lunch is never a detour. Picked because you chose markets over malls in your taste check.
expand_more
Live music
Jazz at La Fontaine after dark — the city's oldest jazz room — and the street brass that owns Strøget by noon.
La Fontaine tables are held until 9pm — movo books the small rooms, not the tourist shows. Picked because live music is pinned in your taste profile.
expand_more
Good evening, David
